about.title: About Me
about.bio_intro: Hello, I am <1>Matheus Reis Mendonca</1>, a Senior Fullstack Developer focused on creating robust, scalable, and efficient systems, acting from data modeling to the user interface.
about.bio_trajectory_p1: With a strong background of almost a decade working with databases and more than 4 years dedicated to software development, I acquired a deep and systemic view of how successful applications are architected behind the scenes.
about.bio_trajectory_p2: My main expertise lies in the backend using <1>C# and the .NET platform</1>, which I employ in the development of scalable REST APIs for corporate systems, ensuring the performance of the most complex business logic.
about.bio_work_p1: I believe that the true value of technology is in solving business problems elegantly. My Fullstack profile allows me to navigate smoothly through the entire development pipeline of the application lifecycle — helping companies reduce communication noise between frontend and backend barriers.

reels.subtitle: Turn a Bible verse into a vertical video ready for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Pick the scenery, adjust the composition and download the MP4.
reels.step_verse_hint: Use the verse of the day, search a reference, or paste your own text.

reels.step_video_hint: Hover a card to watch the clip move.
reels.step_style_hint: Start from a preset, then adjust whatever you like.
reels.verse_search_hint: Type book, chapter and verse. e.g. Psalms 23:1 or John 3:16.
reels.verse_search_error: We couldn't find that verse. Check the reference.
reels.verse_daily_error: Couldn't load the verse of the day.
reels.verse_manual_placeholder: Paste or type the verse here.

reels.step_audio_hint: A voice reading the verse. Optional.

reels.audio_fellback: The chosen voice didn't answer; using {{voice}}.
reels.warning_narration_overflow: The narration runs {{seconds}}s past the video length and would be cut off at the end.
reels.music_empty: No tracks in the public/music/ folder. Drop MP3, M4A, OGG or WAV files there and they show up here.
reels.music_ducking_hint: The music ducks on its own while the voice speaks and comes back in between.

reels.step_content_hint: A Bible verse or a motivational quote.
